title: Graph transpose of a normalized sheaf map through derived units
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, q:W→V proper, v:V→Y separated etale, f=qv, and c=(i,g) a compactification. Suppose tau:q* v!→i! g* has the normalization into f* in the Lean signature: composing with the compactification inclusion gives the usual v!→v* map on q* followed by the direct-image compositor. For every homotopy complex J, transpose under Dv!⊣Dv* the exact v! homotopy comparison followed by Qh(tau_J) and the unit for exact i! followed by Rg*. Follow by exact proper base change for g along v. The result equals the q right-derived unit followed by T_(QhJ) of [def-pur-proper-clopen-graph-transfer]. No compact-support composition or chosen comparisons occur. Finite coefficients, Noetherian schemes, quasi-compactness of v, and chosen compactifications of v and qv are not required.

source.place: Tags 0F7B, 0F7I, 0F7J; graph support description in etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0F4L; SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11

proof.text: Transpose tau on sheaves and follow by base change. After inclusion in the common direct image, the normalization identifies it with the graph adjunction unit. Monicity gives the graph unit on the clopen graph and zero on its complement, hence the explicit sheaf graph transfer.

Apply the equality degreewise. The mixed derived mate unit formula replaces sheaf base change by exact derived base change. Naturality and the proper-composition unit identity move the q-unit in front. The proved graphDerivedIso_unit equation cancels the clopen graph comparison unit, leaving the asserted q-unit followed by T.

lean.statement:
theorem properSheafUnit_graph_transpose
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {W V Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (q : W ⟶ V) [IsProper q]
    (v : V ⟶ Y) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v]
    {f : W ⟶ Y} (hf : f = q ≫ v)
    (c : Compactification f)
    (τ : lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q ⋙
        etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance ⟶
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
    (hτ : ∀ F : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A),
      τ.app F ≫ (compactificationSheafToDirectImage A c).app F =
        etaleLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v
            ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).obj F) ≫
          (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q v f hf).hom.app F)
    (J : HomotopyCategory (Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ)) :
    (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).homEquiv
        _ _
        ((etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app
            ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) |>.obj J) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory τ (.up ℤ)).app J) ≫
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompRightDerivedFunctorUnit
            (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i)
            (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)).app J) ≫
      (exactDerivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g v).toCommSq).app
          ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J)) =
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app J ≫
        ProperGraphTransfer.transfer q v hf c A (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J)
